notes.title: Patch 1.25
notes.content: [p]Hello! Patch 1.25 have some QoL-features and bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Dialog Skip. The most important and the most annoying thing. Now you can skip the dialog lines by pressing any button. Why it was not done before? Nobody knows[/p][/*][*][p]Some of you could may encounter the bug that let you clip through the walls. Well its some kind of physical engine bug and looks like i am not fully beat it yet but i make it harder to do[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some neutral guys not reacting to you[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when pause menu unlocks the camera during the dialog[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some broken enemy paths[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bigfixes [/p][/*][/list]
